name: Urdefhan Lasher

items.name: Necrotic Decay
items.text:
When an urdefhan dies, its invisible flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a 5-foot emanation around the body.

This gas deals 7d6 void damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (DC 24 basic Fortitude save save).

items.name: Constrict
items.text:
1d8+7 slashing damage, DC 25 basic Fortitude save

---

items.name: Shauth Seize
items.text: The lasher gains the Grab ability with a shauth lash and can use their Wicked Bite through magical shauth weapon Strikes.

items.name: Wicked Bite
items.text:
Requirements The urdefhan damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on its last action

---

Effect The urdefhan maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. The urdefhan chooses one of two options, each of which requires a fortitude save. If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

- Drain Blood DC 25 Fortitude save The urdefhan drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is Drained 1 and the urdefhan regains 10 healing HP (or, on a critical failure, it's Drained 2 and the urdefhan regains 20 healing HP).

- Drain Vitality (necromancy) DC 25 Fortitude save The urdefhan draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes Enfeebled 1 for 1 hour on a failed save (or Enfeebled 2 for 1 hour on a critical failure).

text:
Trained from a young age with the strange and powerful shauth lashes, urdefhan lashers would rather die than retreat from combat.

---

Translucent-skinned scourges of the Darklands, urdefhans are remorseless killers and foot soldiers of the world's end.
